description: This file contains unit tests for handling invalid connection preambles in the Orleans framework, specifically testing the server behavior when receiving malformed or invalid preamble sizes over a TCP connection.

classes.name: InvalidPreambleConnectionTests
classes.description: A test class deriving from TestClusterPerTest, designed to verify the behavior of server connections when clients send invalid preamble sizes.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Overrides the cluster configuration to set the connection transport to TCP socket.

methods.name: ShouldCloseConnectionWhenClientSendsInvalidPreambleSize
methods.description: A test method that simulates a client sending an invalid preamble size to the server and asserts that the connection is properly closed.
